items.statement: Status mediation: a Chief-prepared ruling gains force when the Decision Authority adopts it. 2 episodes, both self-reported by the rulings themselves.

Protocol A capture: LOCAL_REF_SET (25 refs, 4020 commits); 51 matches = 3 EXECUTION-TRACE · 47 DOC-OR-GOVERNANCE · 1 UNCLASSIFIABLE. The earliest EXECUTION-TRACE is e4724a44 at 2026-08-04T00:30:25Z, 'WP-4C-1 batch B1 -- RED for K1..K4', RECORDING_ORDER only. Further traces: 939e35dc, cc1a3394 (substantively WP-6 work, L1). No conformance, hypothesis or falsifier statement is made.

Protocol B: no locally checkable channel qualifies as an independent norm-in-force record (F-B1). The overlap test has almost no power, so NOT_INDEPENDENT means 'no evidence of role separation', not 'evidence of role fusion' (F-B2). The only open candidates are the host-side channels and the 23 K-SIG signatures (F-B3).

No regularity qualifies: 0 patterns recur across independent decision clusters, so Section C is empty. Candidates checked and kept in B/E: B04 (2 instances; the sources do not establish independent clusters; both involve R-58, since R32 and R33 are R-58 spans); B05/E04 (n=2, self-reported; IDENTIFIABILITY P4 requires ≥3 different adoption acts); B03 (confounded with time and the authorizing ruling; 2 within one ruling).

items.statement: Waiver: the F-LOG-0190 condition ('We do not declare non-identifiability until the bounded, genuinely informative evidence channels have been exhausted') was knowingly waived. H1 was skipped, not exhausted; Q4 was never evaluated; Protocol C is sealed and not executed.

D1 is a necessary, not sufficient, condition for discrimination: an observable of norm state, independent of the norm-maker, the executor and the self-asserting ruling. Discrimination additionally requires a mapping to the target at t, and a state that one hypothesis predicts and the other excludes. On the acquired evidence D1 holds: work evidence cannot separate 'the norm changed without a recorded act' from 'the work violated an unchanged norm'. Derived on this corpus by a same-family analysis; not validated.
